what: the shield the smith-god made for Achilles: one great round shield, a perfect circle, seen face-on. Round its outer edge runs a broad band of rippling blue-green water, a river that circles the whole rim. Inside the river, the face is worked in rings of tiny raised figures in gold and silver on bronze: an outer ring of little fields with furrows and golden wheat, a ring of tiny walled towns, and in the very centre a round golden sun with a pale silver crescent moon and a few small silver stars beside it.
colours: Warm yellow-brown bronze for the face; bright gold for the wheat, the towns and the sun; pale silver for the moon and stars; a band of blue-green water with white ripples round the rim; dark brown shadows.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face flat towards the viewer, the whole shield inside the picture.
must_show: one great round shield seen face-on
a band of blue-green water running round the whole rim
a gold sun in the centre
rings of tiny gold and silver scenes on bronze

what: a very old sacred round bronze shield from the war at Troy, a perfect circle, gently domed, with a broad flat rim. It is ancient: the bronze is dark and worn smooth, dented by old blows, with dull green patina gathered in its dents and along the rim. A plain raised round boss sits in the middle. Tied round the top of the rim is one white wool ribbon with its two ends hanging down, as offerings were tied in a goddess's temple.
colours: Dark old brown bronze worn to a soft dull gold on the high places; dull blue-green patina in the dents and along the rim; one plain white wool ribbon; dark brown shadows.
pose: Seen from the front, upright, its face flat towards the viewer, the whole shield inside the picture.
must_show: green patina in old dents and on the rim
a plain raised boss in the middle
a white wool ribbon tied at the top of the rim

what: the war spear of a queen of ancient Britain: one long straight thick shaft of honey-brown ash wood with darker brown grain. At its top, a long broad leaf-shaped spearhead of dark grey iron with a raised ridge down its middle and bright edges. Just below the head, a short collar of gold-brown bronze worked with bold curling swirl patterns. Round the shaft below the collar a few turns of a striped woollen strip in green, yellow and blue are bound, with one short loose end. At the bottom end, a small round bronze butt-cap.
colours: Warm honey-brown ash wood with darker brown grain, never white; dark grey iron head with bright silvery edges; warm gold-brown bronze collar and butt-cap with dark swirls; a striped wool strip of green, yellow and blue.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the bronze butt-cap at the bottom left corner and the iron head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: dark grey iron leaf-shaped head at the top right
bronze collar with curling swirls below the head
striped green, yellow and blue wool strip on the shaft

what: the battle standard Joan of Arc carried, as she described it at her trial: one tall straight pole of light brown wood with a small round brass knob on top, and fixed along the top of the pole a long white linen banner that flies out to the right and ends in two pointed tails, edged with a thin fringe of yellow and white silk. The white field is sown with small gold fleurs-de-lis. In the middle of the banner, painted flat on the cloth like a church painting, is one small golden figure of Christ seated on a rainbow, with a gold halo, holding in one hand a small golden orb with a little cross on top, and with one small white angel on each side of him, also painted flat on the cloth. Nothing stands below the banner: the pole runs down bare to its foot.
colours: Bright clean white linen; small gold fleurs-de-lis; a small golden seated figure with a gold halo on a thin rainbow arc; a tiny golden orb with a cross; two small white angels with pale gold wings; light brown pole; a brass knob; a yellow-and-white silk fringe.
pose: The pole stands on a slight diagonal from the bottom left corner up towards the top, and the white banner flies out to the right from the top of the pole, the whole standard inside the picture.
must_show: one tall wooden pole, bare below the banner
a long white banner with two pointed tails
small gold fleurs-de-lis on the white
a small golden seated figure with a halo painted flat in the middle of the banner
a small white angel painted on each side of the figure
